comments.body: hii i actually had the same question because i’m indian and i wanted to go to ETH for my undergraduate degree, but they don’t offer any courses in english. i’m afraid that my grades might be sacrificed due to a language barrier. i’ll definitely major in something engineering related- do you think this is a legitimate concern? is it possible that my grades will be sacrificed, even if i pass the goethe exam at c1 level?
